name: plain-words
description: Report in Simplified Technical English: small words, one idea per sentence, what you did, whether it worked, what to do now. Two options and a recommendation when a decision is needed. Strips the AI tells from everything that gets written, chat and committed documents alike: no em dashes, no filler, no puffery, plain words over fancy ones.
